_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

Options0323.7: engine/ignition variant used by the event, spark, knock and rpm code
Options0323.6: engine variant used by the event, fuel accounting and misfire code (cylinder layout, probably)
Options0323.5: hardware set-up variant at reset (Reset, HardwareCheck)

Options0324.6: manual transmission: GearStateUpdate and the park/neutral monitor are skipped
Options0324.5: transmission controller on the bus (sets EquipmentFlags bit 5)
Options0324.2: PCI bus (SAE J1850 VPW) instead of CCD: PciReceive / PciPitTick run instead of CcdReceive / CcdTransmit

Options0325.7: closed loop off: ClosedLoopMain clears the O2 state and the short-term trim
Options0325.6: flex-fuel (ethanol) calibration: FlexEthanol and the flex learning are used

Options0326.7: selects branches in SwitchInputsRead, SecurityStatusCalc, SciSendByte and AcClutchControl
Options0326.6: fan output variant (FanStatusByte, FanRelayControl, output tests)
Options0326.5: A/C clutch logic on (AcClutchLogicOn); also selects the switch-input map, the VSS constants and the speed control lamp
Options0326.4: board variant used by O2UpdateUpstream, SciSendByte and QspiOutputStatus
Options0326.3: board variant: switch-input map (SwitchBitsCollect), O2UpdateUpstream, SciSendByte, QspiOutputStatus

Options0329.7: upstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (pairs with O2ActiveFlags bits 7/3 and Options033F bit 7)
Options0329.3: selects branches in the fuel event, closed-loop timing, idle and flex code
Options0329.2: knock sensor variant (knock sample, retard, learn and spark code)

Options032A.5: tip-in air temperature check on (TipInAirTempCheck); also used by SparkHook and PurgeMonitorArm
Options032A.4: catalyst temperature sensor fitted (CatTempMonitor; sets EquipmentFlags bit 0)
Options032A.3: battery temperature sensor check variant (both branches exist in BatteryTempSensorCheck)
Options032A.0: battery temperature model on (BattTempModelOn); PciReceive also reads it

Options032B.7: A/C pressure sensor fitted, not a switch (AcPressureSensor): idle A/C steps, clutch, cut and fan
Options032B.4: fuel level from the bus instead of the sender, probably
Options032B.3: power steering pressure switch fitted (sets EquipmentFlags bit 2)

Options032D.4: PWM fan output: output-compare set-up at reset and in the PIT code

Options032E.7: per-event spark on (EventSparkOn); also the cam signal handling (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5, CamSignalCheck)
Options032E.2: part-throttle fuel: MAP is held at the first x point of PartThrottleMapScale as a minimum (CalcFuelPulse)
Options032E.0: idle dip kick mode (IdleDipKickMode); also EquipmentInit and EquipmentDetect

Options032F.1: alternative field control: ChargeControl2 instead of ChargeControl in the PIT code (FieldControlAlt)

Options0330.3: alternative purge duty off closed throttle (PurgeDutyAltOther)
Options0330.2: alternative purge duty at closed throttle (PurgeDutyAltClosed)

Options0331.7: idle flare check off (IdleFlareCheck skips when set)
Options0331.4: development port on: external 16 KB device on chip select 1 at $20000, probably the dual-port RAM of a calibration tool (DevPortInit, DevPortService, DevPortChannel1-8; FinishFuelPulse, StartInjectorPulse and SparkEventCalc write per-event values to it); clear in 05007038 and 05293148AA
Options0331.0: start injector / spark variant (StartInjectorPulse, FinishFuelPulse, SparkEventCalc)

Options0332.2: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect
Options0332.1: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect

Options0335.7: O2 response monitor, sensor 1 (P0133) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 2; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.6: O2 response monitor, sensor 2 (P0153) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 3; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.5: purge flow test on (PurgeFlowTest); purge monitor row 4 of ObdMonitorOptionBits
Options0335.4: catalyst monitor bank 1 (P0420) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 0; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.3: catalyst monitor bank 2 (P0432) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits row 1; also readiness (ObdReadiness)
Options0335.2: misfire monitor variant (MisfireEnableCheck); misfire monitor row 15 of ObdMonitorOptionBits
Options0335.1: leak detection pump fitted (LDP monitor and tests; start and closed-loop branches); LDP monitor row 6 of ObdMonitorOptionBits
Options0335.0: EGR flow monitor supported (EgrFlowMonitor, ObdReadiness); row 5 of ObdMonitorOptionBits

Options0336.7: heater monitor for O2 sensor 1 supported (O2HeaterMonitor, ObdReadiness)
Options0336.6: heater monitor for O2 sensor 2 supported
Options0336.5: heater monitor for O2 sensor 3 (downstream 1) supported
Options0336.4: heater monitor for O2 sensor 4 (downstream 2) supported
Options0336.3: fuel system monitors (P0171/P0172/P0174/P0175) on: ObdMonitorOptionBits rows 11-14

Options0338.5: brake switch, VSS and purge flow monitors variant
